sources.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
sources.snippet: We introduce LLaMA, a collection of foundation language models ranging from 7B to 65B parameters. We train our models on trillions of tokens, and show that it is possible to train state-of-the-art models using publicly available datasets exclusively, without resorting to proprietary and inaccessible datasets.

sources.title: GitHub - huggingface/open-r1: Fully open reproduction of DeepSeek-R1
sources.snippet: A 7B Qwen model trained on CodeForces-CoTs can outperform Claude 3.7 Sonnet on IOI24, while a 32B model can outperform R1 itself. ∞ [2025/02/10] (update #2): We release the OpenR1-Math-220k dataset of 220k traces distilled from R1 on a new version of NuminaMath. Models trained on this dataset match the performance of DeepSeek's distilled ones.
